title: Delaware Children's Museum

services.name: Admission
services.desc: $15.00 general admission; DCM Members and children under 12 months enjoy free admission. Our FREE parking lot is located in Lot K at Beech Street and Shipyard Drive.Teachers and Military Members enjoy free admission on monthly CAPs nights (view event calendar for dates) and Memorial Day, Veterans Day, and Labor Day

services.name: Field Trips
services.desc: The Delaware Children’s Museum offers all the content you find in the classroom, but in the form of a learning playground. From giant building blocks to our giant Kokoun climber, the DCM offers plenty of ways for your group to explore the power of play. Self Guided Field Trips where kids and adults are free to dig further into any activity that interests them. Additional programming is available throughout the week, to make your experience that much better. The DCM provides the ultimate complement to traditional classroom

blurb: Experience new playful learning adventures at the Delaware Children's Museum - the First State's ONLY children's museum! Visit us for interactive exhibits plus rotating fun and educational programs and special events all year long!
